Name: Ice Face
Effect: The Pokémon has 2 Extra HP when it is on "Ice Face form". If the Ice receives 2 damage, change the Pokémon's form to "No-Ice Form". To restore "Ice Face Form" the Pokémon must be out one whole Round while Hail/Snow weather is active. Unique Ability.
Description: This Pokémon's face is covered by a thick block of ice that serves as a cover for its body. If it breaks it will need freezing temperatures to restore the ice block.
